services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full system design and installation for new builds or upgrades. We spec the right radiators and pipework for your home's size and layout.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair

services.title: Pipe Repairs & Replacements

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing Slough residents overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Blue Frog Plumbing & Heating Ltd was founded 18 years ago to bring honest, skilled plumbing and heating work to Slough and the surrounding areas. We've grown from a one-man operation into a trusted local team, with every engineer Gas Safe Registered and fully trained. Over two decades, we've completed over 2,400 jobs and built a reputation for turning up on time, fixing things right, and charging fair prices.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone, we show up when we say we will, and we explain what's wrong before we reach for the invoice. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or recommend work you don't need. That's why nine in ten of our jobs come from repeat customers or referrals — word of mouth matters more to us than any advert.
reviews_heading: What Slough Homeowners Say About Blue Frog

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe on New Year's Eve. Called Blue Frog at 10 pm expecting an emergency charge, but they came out within 50 minutes and sorted it for a fair price. The engineer was polite and explained everything he was doing. Brilliant service, will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in during the cold snap. Rang in the morning and they had a new one fitted and tested by late afternoon. Couldn't believe how quick and professional they were. The installation was clean, no mess, and they left the house spotless.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: I've used Blue Frog three times now — boiler service, a radiator repair, and a leaking joint. Every time they've been helpful, honest, and never tried to sell me something I don't need. Fair prices and good lads. Wouldn't go anywhere else.
reviews.author: David K.
